tenderSchedule.title: SUPPLY OF POWRAKARMIKA FOOD FOR UDUPI CMC
tenderSchedule.description: SUPPLY OF POWRAKARMIKA FOOD FOR UDUPI CMC FOR THE YEAR 2026-27

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer should be tested and supplied the Food similar to the type specified in the Schedule of Daily Morning Breakfast to the SWM Workers in Ward No. up to at least 50% of the quantity required in any one of the last 1 years to any ULB or Govt.Organization in India. Any central,state,semi Governmentorganization or any Government undertaking organization and Satisfactorily completed at least one similar works of value not less than 50 % of the Estimated Amount as a prime contractor in the year 2024-25 to 2025-26, 2026-27.

The bidder in case of Authorized Dealer/Distributor should have minimum annual turnover of Rs.58.66 Lakhs, during any two years out of preceding 3 years i.e., 2024-25 to 2025-26, 2026-27. CA certificate with UDIN number is to be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Only duly registered Firm,Company,licensee from any ULB can submit the tenders.
The supplier has to be registered under FSS Act. 2006.

For outside tenderer out of udupi CMC limit ,The Supplier should have local service support in Udupi city municipal council and Local arrangement MOU or agreement should be submitted and outlet from the food has been delivered should be FSSAI certified
Valid GST Certificate of the firm should be submitted.
No Black list certificate should be submitted valid upto at time of tender submission.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of the firm with UDIN number
